blocks.zh: 風險分流模型：步驟一至四
blocks.en: Risk Triage Model: Steps 1 to 4

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「風險分流（Risk Triage）」的概念，及其在藥品短缺預防中的角色，並能區分哪些產品需要主動管理。
blocks.en: Understand the concept of "risk triage", its role in drug shortage prevention, and how to distinguish which products need proactive management.

blocks.zh: 掌握風險分流模型的四步驟框架（PHA 初步危害分析法），能從衝擊評估到風控策略系統化執行。
blocks.en: Master the four-step framework of the risk triage model (PHA, Preliminary Hazards Analysis), and be able to apply it systematically from impact assessment through to risk control strategies.

blocks.zh: 能正確使用 Table 6.1.1-1🔍 的衝擊矩陣，根據治療用途與替代品可及性，將產品分級為風險等級 A、B 或 C。
blocks.en: Be able to use the impact matrix in Table 6.1.1-1🔍 correctly, classifying products as Risk Level A, B or C according to therapeutic use and availability of alternatives.

blocks.zh: 能應用 Table 6.1.3-1🔍 的優先順序矩陣，結合衝擊等級與短缺可能性，判定風險優先等級 1、2 或 3。
blocks.en: Be able to apply the priority matrix in Table 6.1.3-1🔍, combining impact level with likelihood of shortage to determine Risk Priority Level 1, 2 or 3.

blocks.zh: 了解各優先等級對應的控制策略，包括 CPV、VSM、多元供應源及藥品短缺預防與應變計畫的應用時機。
blocks.en: Understand the control strategies that correspond to each priority level, including when to apply CPV, VSM, multisourcing and the Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan.

blocks.zh: 6.0   Risk Triage Model  ｜  風險分流模型概述
blocks.en: 6.0   Risk Triage Model

blocks.zh: 解說與重點 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻：急診室分流（Triage）
blocks.en: Analogy: Emergency Room Triage

blocks.zh: 「Triage（分流）」源自急診醫學。急診室每天湧入大量病患，護理師必須快速判斷——哪些人需要立刻處置，哪些人可以等候？這個優先排序的過程就叫「triage」。
blocks.en: "Triage" comes from emergency medicine. An emergency room receives a flood of patients every day, and the nurse must quickly decide who needs treatment immediately and who can wait. This prioritization process is called triage.

blocks.zh: TR68 將同樣的概念搬進藥品供應鏈管理：面對成百上千個品項，企業必須先快速評估「哪些產品一旦短缺，對病患的傷害最大？」，再集中資源在這些高風險品項上。
blocks.en: TR68 brings the same idea into pharmaceutical supply chain management: faced with hundreds or thousands of products, a company must first quickly assess "which products would harm patients most if they were short?" and then concentrate resources on those high-risk products.

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：並非每個產品都需要同等資源，資源應流向最需要保護的地方。
blocks.en: Core logic: not every product needs the same level of resources; resources should go where protection is needed most.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QRM 的雙向角色
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two Roles of QRM

blocks.zh: TR68 強調 QRM（Quality Risk Management）必須同時具備兩個面向：
blocks.en: TR68 stresses that QRM (Quality Risk Management) must have two aspects at the same time:

blocks.zh: 主動預防（Proactive）：短缺發生前，建立防線。例如識別高風險產品、建立庫存緩衝、評估供應商穩定性。
blocks.en: Proactive prevention: build defenses before a shortage occurs. Examples: identifying high-risk products, building inventory buffers, assessing supplier stability.

blocks.zh: 被動應變（Reactive）：短缺已發生時，啟動應變計畫，最小化損害。
blocks.en: Reactive response: when a shortage has already occurred, activate the response plan to minimize harm.

blocks.zh: 本節（6.0）聚焦主動預防端，而應變計畫的細節則在 Section 7.0 說明。
blocks.en: This section (6.0) focuses on the proactive prevention side; the details of the response plan are covered in Section 7.0.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Drug Shortage Risk Register 的五大內容
blocks.en: Key Point: The Five Contents of the Drug Shortage Risk Register

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺風險登記表（Risk Register）是整個 QRM 體系的「單一資訊來源（Single Source of Truth）」，必須涵蓋：
blocks.en: The Drug Shortage Risk Register is the "Single Source of Truth" of the whole QRM system and must cover:

blocks.zh: 潛在短缺風險的描述（含 API、賦形劑及其來源）
blocks.en: A description of the potential shortage risk (including API, excipients and their sources)

blocks.zh: 可能受影響的國家/地區
blocks.en: Countries/regions that may be affected

blocks.zh: 現行控制措施及其有效性評估
blocks.en: Current controls and an assessment of their effectiveness

blocks.zh: 風險等級（考量現行控制後的殘餘風險）
blocks.en: Risk level (the residual risk after taking current controls into account)

blocks.zh: 早期預警指標（leading indicators）與落後指標（lagging indicators）
blocks.en: Early warning indicators (leading indicators) and lagging indicators

blocks.zh: 此登記表應定期更新與審查，不是「一次性文件」。
blocks.en: This register should be updated and reviewed regularly; it is not a "one-time document".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Risk Control Plan 的六大要素
blocks.en: Key Point: The Six Elements of the Risk Control Plan

blocks.zh: 風控計畫（Risk Control Plan）中應處理的議題包括：
blocks.en: Topics to be addressed in the Risk Control Plan include:

blocks.zh: 庫存與安全庫存規劃
blocks.en: Inventory and safety stock planning

blocks.zh: 需求與供應規劃（含雙重採購策略 dual sourcing）
blocks.en: Demand and supply planning (including a dual sourcing strategy)

blocks.zh: 製造與配送的產能規劃（產能儲備）
blocks.en: Capacity planning for manufacturing and distribution (capacity reserve)

blocks.zh: 替代療法的可及性
blocks.en: Availability of alternative therapies

blocks.zh: 加速法規機關行動（例如批准批准後變更）
blocks.en: Expediting regulatory authority action (for example, approval of post-approval changes)

blocks.zh: 6.1   Description of the Risk Triage Model  ｜  風險分流模型描述
blocks.en: 6.1   Description of the Risk Triage Model

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PHA（初步危害分析）
blocks.en: Core Concept: PHA (Preliminary Hazards Analysis)

blocks.zh: Preliminary Hazards Analysis（PHA）是一種來自系統安全工程的風險評估方法，適用於在詳細資訊不足時進行快速、早期的危害識別與排序。
blocks.en: Preliminary Hazards Analysis (PHA) is a risk assessment method from system safety engineering, suited to quick, early hazard identification and ranking when detailed information is lacking.

blocks.zh: TR68 採用 PHA 的精神：在短缺發生之前，僅需三項關鍵資訊（治療用途、替代品可及性、短缺可能性）即可快速評估產品風險，不需要耗費大量資源進行深入分析。
blocks.en: TR68 adopts the spirit of PHA: before a shortage occurs, only three key pieces of information (therapeutic use, availability of alternatives, likelihood of shortage) are needed to assess product risk quickly, without spending large resources on in-depth analysis.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三個風險要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Risk Elements

blocks.zh: 風險分流模型的核心是三個維度的交集評估：
blocks.en: The core of the risk triage model is an assessment at the intersection of three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 治療用途（Therapeutic Use）：這個藥品是為了什麼疾病使用的？後果有多嚴重？
blocks.en: Therapeutic Use: What disease is this medicine used for? How serious are the consequences?

blocks.zh: 替代品可及性（Availability of Alternatives）：如果這個產品缺貨，有沒有其他可替代的治療選項？
blocks.en: Availability of Alternatives: If this product is out of stock, are there other therapeutic options that can replace it?

blocks.zh: 短缺可能性（Likelihood of Occurrence）：考量現行控制措施後，這個產品實際發生短缺的機率有多高？
blocks.en: Likelihood of Occurrence: Taking current controls into account, how likely is it that this product will actually become short?

blocks.zh: 前兩者合併決定「衝擊等級（Risk Level A/B/C）」，再與第三者結合產生「優先等級（Priority 1/2/3）」。
blocks.en: The first two together determine the "impact level (Risk Level A/B/C)", which is then combined with the third to produce the "priority level (Priority 1/2/3)".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為何使用關鍵字而非「高/中/低」評分？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Use Keywords Instead of High/Medium/Low Scores?

blocks.zh: 傳統風險評估常使用主觀的「高/中/低」評分，導致不同評估者之間結果不一致。TR68 改用具體的描述性關鍵字（如「無替代品可用」、「有類似療法」），讓評估聚焦在產品的實際特性，減少主觀判斷的空間，提高評估的一致性與可重複性。
blocks.en: Traditional risk assessment often uses subjective "high/medium/low" scores, which leads to inconsistent results between assessors. TR68 instead uses specific descriptive keywords (such as "no alternatives available" and "alternative products available"), so that the assessment focuses on the actual characteristics of the product, leaving less room for subjective judgment and improving consistency and repeatability.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1：識別關鍵字
blocks.en: Exercise 1: Identify the Keywords

blocks.zh: 請根據 Table 6.1-1🔍，為以下場景選擇正確的關鍵字描述：
blocks.en: Based on Table 6.1-1🔍, choose the correct keyword description for each of the following scenarios:

blocks.zh:
抗癌標靶藥物 Trastuzumab（賀癌平），目前市面上僅此一種，無可替代的治療方案。
→ 治療用途：＿＿＿ / 替代品：＿＿＿
blocks.en:
The anticancer targeted drug Trastuzumab (Herceptin) is currently the only one of its kind on the market, with no alternative treatment.
→ Therapeutic use: ___ / Alternatives: ___

blocks.zh:
普通感冒咳嗽糖漿，藥局貨架上有多種品牌可選。
→ 治療用途：＿＿＿ / 替代品：＿＿＿
blocks.en:
An ordinary cold and cough syrup, with many brands available on pharmacy shelves.
→ Therapeutic use: ___ / Alternatives: ___

blocks.zh:
帕金森氏症口服藥（慢性用藥），同類藥物尚有其他廠牌可選。
→ 治療用途：＿＿＿ / 替代品：＿＿＿
blocks.en:
An oral drug for Parkinson's disease (chronic use), with other brands of similar drugs available.
→ Therapeutic use: ___ / Alternatives: ___

blocks.zh: 參考答案：1. High / No alternatives available；2. Low / Same product available；3. Medium / Alternative products available
blocks.en: Reference answers: 1. High / No alternatives available; 2. Low / Same product available; 3. Medium / Alternative products available

blocks.zh: 6.1.1   Step 1: Define Impact to the Patient  ｜  步驟一：定義病患衝擊
blocks.en: 6.1.1   Step 1: Define Impact to the Patient

blocks.zh: 核心概念：衝擊矩陣的邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic of the Impact Matrix

blocks.zh: Table 6.1.1-1🔍 是一個 3×3 的矩陣，縱軸（列）是治療用途嚴重性，橫軸（欄）是替代品可及性。交叉點即為衝擊等級。
blocks.en: Table 6.1.1-1🔍 is a 3×3 matrix. The vertical axis (rows) is the severity of therapeutic use and the horizontal axis (columns) is the availability of alternatives. The intersection gives the impact level.

blocks.zh: 矩陣的設計邏輯很直觀：
blocks.en: The design logic of the matrix is intuitive:

blocks.zh: 治療越關鍵（救命用途）+ 替代品越少 → 衝擊越高 → Risk Level A（紅）
blocks.en: The more critical the treatment (life-saving use) + the fewer the alternatives → the higher the impact → Risk Level A (red)

blocks.zh: 治療次重要 + 有相似替代品可選 → Risk Level B（黃）
blocks.en: Moderately important treatment + similar alternatives available → Risk Level B (yellow)

blocks.zh: 輕微用途 + 替代品充足 → Risk Level C（綠）
blocks.en: Minor use + ample alternatives → Risk Level C (green)

blocks.zh: 比喻：用三個藥品理解 A/B/C
blocks.en: Analogy: Understanding A/B/C with Three Medicines

blocks.zh:
Risk Level A — 胰島素（Insulin）
第一型糖尿病患者每天需要注射胰島素，若缺貨且沒有完全等效的替代品，患者可能在數日內陷入酮酸中毒危及生命。衝擊是即時且不可逆的。→ Risk Level A。
blocks.en:
Risk Level A: Insulin
Patients with type 1 diabetes need insulin injections every day. If it is out of stock and there is no fully equivalent alternative, patients may develop ketoacidosis within days, which is life-threatening. The impact is immediate and irreversible. → Risk Level A.

blocks.zh:
Risk Level B — 地高辛（Digoxin）錠劑
心衰竭用藥。假設 0.25mg 錠劑缺貨，但市面上仍有 0.125mg 錠劑（需調整劑量）或注射劑型可轉換，衝擊降低但仍需謹慎管理。→ Risk Level B。
blocks.en:
Risk Level B: Digoxin tablets
A heart failure drug. Suppose the 0.25mg tablet is out of stock, but 0.125mg tablets (requiring a dose adjustment) or an injectable form to switch to are still on the market. The impact is reduced but still needs careful management. → Risk Level B.

blocks.zh:
Risk Level C — OTC 咳嗽糖漿
感冒咳嗽用，症狀輕微，藥局有多種品牌可選，缺一不礙事。→ Risk Level C。
blocks.en:
Risk Level C: OTC cough syrup
Used for colds and coughs, with mild symptoms and many brands available at pharmacies; losing one makes little difference. → Risk Level C.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多用途產品取最高等級
blocks.en: Key Point: For Multi-Use Products, Take the Highest Level

blocks.zh: 若一個產品同時有多種適應症，且不同適應症對應不同風險等級，應採用最高的等級（保守原則）。
blocks.en: If a product has several indications that correspond to different risk levels, the highest level should be used (the conservative principle).

blocks.zh: 例如：某抗生素在甲適應症屬「醫療必需品（Risk A）」，在乙適應症則屬「慢性病管理（Risk B）」，整體應按 Risk Level A 規劃。
blocks.en: For example: an antibiotic is "medically necessary (Risk A)" for indication X but "chronic disease management (Risk B)" for indication Y; overall it should be planned as Risk Level A.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：替代品評估須諮詢法規機關
blocks.en: Key Point: Alternatives Assessment Requires Consulting Regulatory Authorities

blocks.zh: 替代品的可及性並非僅靠藥品本身判斷，還需考慮：
blocks.en: The availability of alternatives cannot be judged from the medicine alone; you must also consider:

blocks.zh: 替代品在各市場的上市許可狀態
blocks.en: The marketing authorization status of the alternatives in each market

blocks.zh: 療效與安全性的等效程度（是否有相似的副作用或禁忌症）
blocks.en: The degree of equivalence in efficacy and safety (whether side effects or contraindications are similar)

blocks.zh: 特殊族群（小兒、老年、腎衰竭患者）的劑型適用性
blocks.en: The suitability of the dosage form for special populations (children, the elderly, patients with renal failure)

blocks.zh: 需要諮詢相關主管機關，確認替代品在當地市場的可及性
blocks.en: The need to consult the relevant authorities to confirm the availability of alternatives in the local market

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2：衝擊等級分類
blocks.en: Exercise 2: Impact Level Classification

blocks.zh: 請查閱 Table 6.1.1-1🔍，判斷以下產品的 Risk Level（並說明原因）：
blocks.en: Refer to Table 6.1.1-1🔍 and determine the Risk Level of each of the following products (and explain why):

blocks.zh: Trastuzumab（賀癌平）：用於 HER2 陽性乳癌，目前無任何等效生物相似藥上市。
blocks.en: Trastuzumab (Herceptin): used for HER2-positive breast cancer; there is currently no equivalent biosimilar on the market.

blocks.zh: 血漿蛋白療法：急/慢性用途，但市面上有不同廠牌的相同規格產品可取代。
blocks.en: Plasma protein therapy: acute/chronic use, but products of the same specification from different brands are available as replacements.

blocks.zh: Metformin（二甲雙胍）：第二型糖尿病一線用藥（慢性），同藥理機轉之替代藥物（如 SGLT-2 抑制劑）有限但存在。
blocks.en: Metformin: first-line drug for type 2 diabetes (chronic); alternative drugs with the same pharmacological mechanism (such as SGLT-2 inhibitors) are limited but exist.

blocks.zh: 參考答案：1. Risk Level A（救命用途 + 無替代品）；2. Risk Level C（急慢性用途 + 相同產品可取得）；3. Risk Level B（急慢性用途 + 有替代品但非完全等效）
blocks.en: Reference answers: 1. Risk Level A (life-saving use + no alternatives); 2. Risk Level C (acute/chronic use + same product obtainable); 3. Risk Level B (acute/chronic use + alternatives available but not fully equivalent)

blocks.zh: 6.1.2   Step 2: Assess the Likelihood of Shortage  ｜  步驟二：評估短缺可能性
blocks.en: 6.1.2   Step 2: Assess the Likelihood of Shortage

blocks.zh: 比喻：單引擎 vs 雙引擎飛機
blocks.en: Analogy: Single-Engine vs Twin-Engine Aircraft

blocks.zh: 想像兩架飛機橫越太平洋：
blocks.en: Imagine two aircraft crossing the Pacific:

blocks.zh: 單引擎飛機：只要那一具引擎故障，飛機立刻面臨危機，沒有後備。→ 單一來源（Single-source）供應，短缺可能性高（High）。
blocks.en: Single-engine aircraft: if that one engine fails, the aircraft is in immediate danger with no backup. → Single-source supply; likelihood of shortage is High.

blocks.zh: 雙引擎飛機 + 備用燃料：一具引擎故障，另一具可繼續飛行，加上有備用燃料，危機耐受度高。→ 多元來源（Multi-source）+ 充足安全庫存，短缺可能性低（Low）。
blocks.en: Twin-engine aircraft + reserve fuel: if one engine fails, the other can keep flying, and with reserve fuel the tolerance to a crisis is high. → Multi-source supply + adequate safety stock; likelihood of shortage is Low.

blocks.zh: 藥品供應鏈的邏輯相同：現行控制措施越完善，短缺可能性越低。
blocks.en: The logic is the same in the drug supply chain: the better the current controls, the lower the likelihood of shortage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：定性評估即可，不須量化
blocks.en: Key Point: A Qualitative Assessment Is Enough; Quantification Is Not Required

blocks.zh: TR68 明確指出，短缺可能性的評估不一定需要量化（例如給出 30% 概率），重要的是：
blocks.en: TR68 states clearly that the assessment of likelihood of shortage does not necessarily need to be quantified (for example, by giving a 30% probability). What matters is to:

blocks.zh: 理解現有控制措施是否有效
blocks.en: Understand whether the existing controls are effective

blocks.zh: 能夠相對比較各危害的可能性高低
blocks.en: Be able to compare the relative likelihood of the various hazards

blocks.zh: 使用三級尺度（高/中/低）即可滿足分流模型的需求。這與傳統精細的 FMEA 計分方式不同，強調的是實用性與效率。
blocks.en: A three-level scale (high/medium/low) is enough to meet the needs of the triage model. This differs from the detailed scoring of traditional FMEA and emphasizes practicality and efficiency.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：短缺可能性的影響因子
blocks.en: Core Concept: Factors Affecting Likelihood of Shortage

blocks.zh: 評估短缺可能性時，需考量以下控制措施是否到位及其有效性：
blocks.en: When assessing likelihood of shortage, consider whether the following controls are in place and how effective they are:

blocks.zh: 6.1.3   Step 3: Assess Risk Priority Levels  ｜  步驟三：評定風險優先等級
blocks.en: 6.1.3   Step 3: Assess Risk Priority Levels

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩軸合一，產出優先等級
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Axes Combined to Produce the Priority Level

blocks.zh: 步驟三是步驟一與步驟二的「交叉點」——將衝擊等級（A/B/C）與短缺可能性（高/中/低）對應到 Table 6.1.3-1🔍，即可得出：
blocks.en: Step 3 is the "intersection" of Step 1 and Step 2: map the impact level (A/B/C) and the likelihood of shortage (high/medium/low) onto Table 6.1.3-1🔍 to obtain:

blocks.zh: Priority Level 1（紅）：必須制定預防措施與應變計畫
blocks.en: Priority Level 1 (red): preventive measures and a response plan must be developed

blocks.zh: Priority Level 2（黃）：建議制定措施；可選擇接受殘餘風險
blocks.en: Priority Level 2 (yellow): measures are recommended; the residual risk may be accepted

blocks.zh: Priority Level 3（綠）：一般可接受的風險水準
blocks.en: Priority Level 3 (green): generally an acceptable level of risk

blocks.zh: 實際計算範例：晚期癌症生物製劑
blocks.en: Worked Example: Biologic for Advanced Cancer

blocks.zh:
Step 1 衝擊評估：晚期癌症治療用生物製劑，市面上無替代品（無論上市或在臨床試驗中）。
→ 治療用途：救命（Medically Necessary）；替代品：無（No Alternatives Available）
→ Risk Level A
blocks.en:
Step 1 Impact assessment: a biologic used to treat advanced cancer, with no alternatives on the market (whether marketed or in clinical trials).
→ Therapeutic use: life-saving (Medically Necessary); alternatives: none (No Alternatives Available)
→ Risk Level A

blocks.zh:
Step 2 可能性評估：產品為雙重來源（dual-sourced），但庫存儲備不足以應對重大製造或品質問題。
→ 有兩個製造商（中度控制），但無充足安全庫存（控制不足）
→ 中度可能性（Medium Likelihood）
blocks.en:
Step 2 Likelihood assessment: the product is dual-sourced, but inventory reserves are not enough to cope with a major manufacturing or quality problem.
→ Two manufacturers (moderate control), but no adequate safety stock (insufficient control)
→ Medium Likelihood

blocks.zh:
Step 3 優先等級：查表 6.1.3-1，Risk Level A × Medium Likelihood
→ Risk Priority Level 1（必須制定預防與應變計畫）
blocks.en:
Step 3 Priority level: refer to Table 6.1.3-1, Risk Level A × Medium Likelihood
→ Risk Priority Level 1 (prevention and response plans must be developed)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：備用廠房切換時間的判斷基準
blocks.en: Key Point: Criteria for Judging Backup Site Switchover Time

blocks.zh: TR68 提供了可能性評估的具體時間參考值：
blocks.en: TR68 gives specific time reference values for the likelihood assessment:

blocks.zh: 短缺可能性高：單一來源，無備用廠房
blocks.en: High likelihood of shortage: single source, no backup site

blocks.zh: 短缺可能性中：有備用廠房，但準備投產至少需要 6 個月以上；或短期庫存充足但長期不足
blocks.en: Medium likelihood of shortage: a backup site exists, but it needs at least 6 months to be ready for production; or short-term inventory is sufficient but long-term inventory is not

blocks.zh: 短缺可能性低：備用廠房已啟動，或在 4 個月內即可投產；且庫存水準充足
blocks.en: Low likelihood of shortage: the backup site is already active, or can be in production within 4 months; and inventory levels are sufficient

blocks.zh: 這些時間門檻可作為企業制定備用廠房啟動計畫的參考基準。
blocks.en: These time thresholds can serve as a reference basis for companies developing backup site activation plans.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3：走一遍完整流程
blocks.en: Exercise 3: Walk Through the Complete Process

blocks.zh: 情境：一款用於多發性硬化症（MS）的口服藥，長期慢性使用，市面上有另外兩種不同機轉的 MS 療法可替代。該藥目前單一來源製造，且庫存僅剩 2 個月供應量。
blocks.en: Scenario: an oral drug for multiple sclerosis (MS), used chronically over the long term, with two other MS therapies with different mechanisms available as alternatives. The drug is currently single-source manufactured, and only 2 months of supply remains in stock.

blocks.zh: Step 1：治療用途 → ＿＿＿ ；替代品 → ＿＿＿ ；Risk Level → ＿＿＿
blocks.en: Step 1: Therapeutic use → ___ ; Alternatives → ___ ; Risk Level → ___

blocks.zh: Step 2：單一來源 + 庫存不足 → 可能性 → ＿＿＿
blocks.en: Step 2: Single source + insufficient inventory → Likelihood → ___

blocks.zh: Step 3：查表 6.1.3-1 → Risk Priority Level → ＿＿＿
blocks.en: Step 3: Refer to Table 6.1.3-1 → Risk Priority Level → ___

blocks.zh: 結論：需要哪種層級的應對措施？
blocks.en: Conclusion: What level of response is needed?

blocks.zh: 參考答案：1. Acute/Chronic / Alternative Products Available / Risk Level B；2. High；3. Priority Level 1；4. 必須制定預防措施與應變計畫。
blocks.en: Reference answers: 1. Acute/Chronic / Alternative Products Available / Risk Level B; 2. High; 3. Priority Level 1; 4. Preventive measures and a response plan must be developed.

blocks.zh: 6.1.4   Step 4: Develop and Implement Preventive Risk Control Strategies  ｜  步驟四：制定與執行預防性風控策略
blocks.en: 6.1.4   Step 4: Develop and Implement Preventive Risk Control Strategies

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三大關鍵工具
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Key Tools

blocks.zh: 1. VSM（Value Stream Mapping，價值流程圖）
blocks.en: 1. VSM (Value Stream Mapping)

blocks.zh: VSM 是精實製造（Lean Manufacturing）的工具，用於繪製從起始原料到成品配送的完整供應流，以視覺化方式識別庫存與製造的風險壓力點（stress points）。對 Priority 1 產品為強制執行，Priority 2 建議用於特定製程節點。
blocks.en: VSM is a Lean Manufacturing tool used to map the complete supply flow from starting materials to finished product distribution, visually identifying the stress points of inventory and manufacturing risk. It is mandatory for Priority 1 products, and recommended for specific process nodes for Priority 2.

blocks.zh: 2. CPV（Continuous Process Verification，持續製程確效）
blocks.en: 2. CPV (Continuous Process Verification)

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 所定義的 Stage 3 製程確效。CPV 透過持續收集與分析製程數據，在問題真正導致批次失敗之前，提前偵測製造異常趨勢。對 Priority 1 產品必須實施完整 CPV 計畫；Priority 2 至少要將 CPV 計畫納入藥品短缺管理活動的額外審查。
blocks.en: Stage 3 process validation as defined in ICH Q10. By continuously collecting and analyzing process data, CPV detects adverse manufacturing trends early, before a problem actually causes a batch failure. A full CPV program must be implemented for Priority 1 products; for Priority 2, at least include the CPV program as an additional review in drug shortage management activities.

blocks.zh: 3. 多元供應源（Multisourcing）
blocks.en: 3. Multisourcing

blocks.zh: 建立備用 API 供應商、備用製造廠，降低單點故障（single point of failure）風險。Priority 1 產品須進行多元供應源需求評估，並納入高階管理層決策；Priority 2 產品進行成本效益分析。
blocks.en: Establish backup API suppliers and backup manufacturing sites to reduce the risk of a single point of failure. Priority 1 products must undergo a multisourcing needs assessment, with the outcome taken into senior management decision-making; Priority 2 products undergo a cost-benefit analysis.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風控策略需嵌入 QMS
blocks.en: Key Point: Risk Control Strategies Must Be Embedded in the QMS

blocks.zh: TR68 強調，風控策略不能只是紙上談兵——應：
blocks.en: TR68 emphasizes that risk control strategies cannot remain on paper only; they should:

blocks.zh: 以書面程序（SOP）文件化
blocks.en: Be documented in written procedures (SOPs)

blocks.zh: 整合進公司品質系統（QMS）及業務流程
blocks.en: Be integrated into the company quality system (QMS) and business processes

blocks.zh: 以一致方式在全公司推行
blocks.en: Be implemented consistently across the whole company

blocks.zh: 透過 Drug Shortage Risk Register 主動管理
blocks.en: Be actively managed through the Drug Shortage Risk Register

blocks.zh: Risk Register（Section 11.0 附錄一有範本）是所有風控措施的追蹤中心，應定期審查。
blocks.en: The Risk Register (a template is in Section 11.0, Appendix 1) is the tracking hub for all risk control measures and should be reviewed regularly.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Priority 1 = 飛行前預檢 vs Priority 3 = 一般例行保養
blocks.en: Analogy: Priority 1 = Pre-Flight Inspection vs Priority 3 = Routine Maintenance

blocks.zh: 航空業有嚴格分級：
blocks.en: The aviation industry has strict tiering:

blocks.zh: 長程國際客機（高影響、高可見度）：每次飛行前都要做詳細安全檢查（CPV 類比），飛行員和工程師都要確認備用系統就緒（VSM + 多元來源類比）。
blocks.en: Long-haul international airliner (high impact, high visibility): a detailed safety check before every flight (analogous to CPV), with pilots and engineers confirming that backup systems are ready (analogous to VSM + multisourcing).

blocks.zh: 地面服務車輛（低影響）：按月保養，不用每次出車前做航前檢查。
blocks.en: Ground service vehicle (low impact): serviced monthly, with no pre-trip inspection before each use.

blocks.zh: TR68 的 Priority 1/2/3 分層，就是讓企業像航空業一樣：把最嚴格的控制，放在最關鍵的地方。
blocks.en: The Priority 1/2/3 tiering in TR68 lets companies do as the aviation industry does: put the strictest controls where they matter most.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4：制定風控行動
blocks.en: Exercise 4: Develop Risk Control Actions

blocks.zh: 承接思考練習 3 的 MS 口服藥（Risk Priority Level 1，單一來源，庫存不足），請列出至少 4 項具體的優先控制行動，並說明應用哪個工具或策略：
blocks.en: Continuing from the MS oral drug in Exercise 3 (Risk Priority Level 1, single source, insufficient inventory), list at least 4 specific priority control actions and state which tool or strategy applies to each:
Action 1: ___ (Tool: ___)
Action 2: ___ (Tool: ___)
Action 3: ___ (Tool: ___)
Action 4: ___ (Tool: ___)

blocks.zh: 可能的答案方向：1. 繪製完整供應鏈 VSM，識別庫存壓力點（VSM）；2. 評估備用 API 供應商，啟動雙重採購（Multisourcing）；3. 建立持續製程確效計畫，提前偵測製程異常（CPV）；4. 制定藥品短缺預防與應變計畫，並建立與法規機關的溝通機制（Drug Shortage Prevention & Response Plan）。
blocks.en: Possible answer directions: 1. Map the complete supply chain with VSM to identify inventory stress points (VSM); 2. Assess backup API suppliers and start dual sourcing (Multisourcing); 3. Establish a continuous process verification program to detect process anomalies early (CPV); 4. Develop a drug shortage prevention and response plan, and set up a communication mechanism with regulatory authorities (Drug Shortage Prevention & Response Plan).

blocks.zh: Section 3A 章節總結 Summary
blocks.en: Section 3A Summary

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋 TR68 Section 6.0–6.1.4，介紹風險分流模型（Risk Triage Model）的理論基礎與四步驟操作框架。
blocks.en: This section covers TR68 Sections 6.0 to 6.1.4, presenting the theoretical basis of the Risk Triage Model and its four-step operating framework.

blocks.zh: 6.0 Risk Triage Model：採用「分流（Triage）」概念，讓企業快速識別哪些產品需要主動的藥品短缺預防管理。並非所有產品都需要同等資源，QRM 體系應同時具備主動預防（Drug Shortage Risk Register）與被動應變（Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan）兩個面向。
blocks.en: 6.0 Risk Triage Model: adopts the "triage" concept so that companies can quickly identify which products need proactive drug shortage prevention management. Not every product needs the same level of resources, and the QRM system should have both a proactive prevention aspect (Drug Shortage Risk Register) and a reactive response aspect (Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan).

blocks.zh: 6.1 四步驟 PHA 分流框架：使用初步危害分析（PHA）方法，評估三個風險要素（治療用途、替代品可及性、短缺可能性），並以關鍵字描述代替主觀評分，提高評估一致性。
blocks.en: 6.1 Four-Step PHA Triage Framework: uses the Preliminary Hazards Analysis (PHA) method to assess three risk elements (therapeutic use, availability of alternatives, likelihood of shortage), and uses keyword descriptions instead of subjective scores to improve assessment consistency.

blocks.zh: 6.1.1 Step 1 — 衝擊等級（Risk Level A/B/C）：透過 3×3 矩陣交叉評估治療用途嚴重性與替代品可及性。Risk Level A（紅）= 最高衝擊；C（綠）= 最低衝擊。多用途產品取最高等級。
blocks.en: 6.1.1 Step 1: Impact Level (Risk Level A/B/C): a 3×3 matrix cross-assesses the severity of therapeutic use and the availability of alternatives. Risk Level A (red) = highest impact; C (green) = lowest impact. For multi-use products, take the highest level.

blocks.zh: 6.1.2 Step 2 — 短缺可能性（High/Medium/Low）：評估現行控制措施（供應來源、庫存、製造備援、流程穩定性）。單一來源 + 庫存不足 → 高可能性；多元來源 + 充足備援 → 低可能性。定性三級評估即可，不需量化。
blocks.en: 6.1.2 Step 2: Likelihood of Shortage (High/Medium/Low): assess current controls (supply sources, inventory, manufacturing redundancy, process stability). Single source + insufficient inventory → high likelihood; multiple sources + adequate redundancy → low likelihood. A qualitative three-level assessment is enough; no quantification is needed.

blocks.zh: 6.1.3 Step 3 — 風險優先等級（Priority 1/2/3）：查對矩陣 Table 6.1.3-1🔍，Risk Level 與 Likelihood 的交叉點決定優先等級。Priority 1 = 必須制定預防措施；Priority 3 = 一般可接受風險，定期審查即可。
blocks.en: 6.1.3 Step 3: Risk Priority Level (Priority 1/2/3): refer to the matrix Table 6.1.3-1🔍; the intersection of Risk Level and Likelihood determines the priority level. Priority 1 = preventive measures must be developed; Priority 3 = generally acceptable risk, periodic review is enough.

blocks.zh: 6.1.4 Step 4 — 風控策略：Priority 1 需要 VSM + 多元供應源評估 + CPV + 應變計畫 + 法規溝通機制；Priority 2 考量 VSM 及成本效益分析；Priority 3 定期審查。所有策略應嵌入 QMS 並透過 Drug Shortage Risk Register 主動管理。
blocks.en: 6.1.4 Step 4: Risk Control Strategies: Priority 1 requires VSM + multisourcing assessment + CPV + a response plan + a regulatory communication mechanism; Priority 2 considers VSM and cost-benefit analysis; Priority 3 is reviewed periodically. All strategies should be embedded in the QMS and actively managed through the Drug Shortage Risk Register.
